# Elora — Full Entity Reference

## What is Elora?
Elora is a voice-first AI journaling application for iOS and Android. It transcribes voice journal entries, analyzes text and voice entries for emotional patterns, and generates personalized insights. All entries are encrypted end-to-end. Elora is free to download with an optional Elora Premium subscription.

## Platforms
- iOS (iPhone, iPad) — App Store
- Android (phones, tablets) — Google Play

## Download Links
- https://apps.apple.com/au/app/elora-journal-with-insight/id6753067869
- https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.elora.ai

## Features

### Voice Journaling
Speak journal entries naturally. Elora transcribes voice recordings into text automatically.

### Text Journaling
Type journal entries using the on-device keyboard.

### AI Summaries & Insights
Each entry is analyzed for emotional themes, key topics, and recurring patterns. Summaries are generated and surfaced in the timeline.

### Emotional Pattern Detection
Elora tracks moods, emotional themes, and topics across entries. Patterns are visualized over weeks and months.

### Explore (Chat with Your Journal)
A conversational interface that answers questions based on your journal history. Users can ask about past entries, recurring themes, or personal growth trends.

### Soul Map
A graph visualization connecting thoughts, emotions, and recurring themes across journal entries.

### Guided Reflection Prompts
When users are unsure what to write, Elora suggests prompts based on their own journal patterns.

### Offline-First Storage
Entries are saved on-device first and sync securely when online. Journaling works without an internet connection.

### End-to-End Encryption
All journal entries are encrypted end-to-end. Only the user can read their entries.

### Cross-Device Sync
Journal data syncs securely across iOS and Android devices when signed into the same account.

## Pricing
- Free tier: journaling, AI summaries, voice transcription, pattern tracking, guided prompts
- Elora Premium: USD 4.99/month (Monthly or Annual subscription) — unlimited Explore chat, advanced insights, cross-device sync

## Privacy
- End-to-end encryption on all journal entries
- No data sold to third parties
- No advertising
- No AI model training on user journal entries
- Voice recordings: processed for transcription, deleted from servers shortly after
- AI providers: Anthropic and OpenAI (API access, not used for model training)
- Users can export or delete data at any time

## AI Providers
- Anthropic — AI summarization and emotional theme analysis
- OpenAI — AI prompts, contextual insights, and chat
